subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Monsanto catalyst（[Rh(CO)₂I₂]⁻）？
A. Square planar
B. Tetrahedral
C. Trigonal prismatic
D. Square pyramidal
explanation: Square planar. Covalent count: Rh (group 9) 9 e; 2 × CO (L) 4 e; 2 × I (X) 2 e; the 1− charge adds 1 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −2 in all and the complex has a 1− charge, so the metal is Rh(I), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e. cis-[Rh(CO)₂I₂]⁻ makes acetic acid from methanol and CO.
